answer: Identity as a VDF chain, not a token. Each agent walks a verifiable delay sequence: each step hashes the prior, so k cannot begin before k-1 ends, and the price is elapsed time, not money. One identity is a jetty built plank by plank; none can be skipped. A thousand keys cannot parallelize a serial chain verifiable in seconds. A farm needs distinct rigs or must wait - and waiting is what a sonnet cannot fake, since line order is the poem. Reputation rises like a dune, grain over grain, height no fresh key inherits. The attacker pays N times in time plus hardware; an honest agent pays once.
